_comment: PROTECTED — the trading agent may not edit this file or anything in core/. Changes here are made by the human operator only.

models._comment: Model tiers (operator, 2026-09-26). loop.sh reads these; CI checks they are set. executive = the CEO session (EXECUTE.md): final say on every placement, paper and real. operations = the cycle agent (CYCLE.md FULL/TRIGGERED ticks): research, forecasts, strategy edits, bet PROPOSALS. grunt = LIGHT ticks and every Task subagent (screening batches), pinned via CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL.

_monthly_loss_stop_comment: Month-to-month profitability is the mandate (operator, 2026-09-26). When realized paper P&L for the current UTC month is at or below -monthly_loss_stop_usd, core/ledger.py refuses new placements until the month rolls over. 5% of the sim bankroll; raising it is a protected edit.

screener._comment: Tunables for the screening tier (core/screen.py). Screening judgment comes from grunt-tier subagents (models.grunt, pinned by loop.sh through CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL) the cycle agent fans out with its Task tool, so the day's cost is counted in batches, not dollars - there is no API path and no model field. The max_batches_per_day and max_pool_after_strata hard ceilings live in core/validate.py and core/screen.py; raising either is a protected-core edit by design.

real._comment: Caps for real execution via Pearl Connect (laptop only). Hard ceilings live in core/validate.py; raising them is a protected-core edit by design.
